classes.name: Did not look
classes.definition: The bot answered or acted without reading the source that held what the turn needed.
classes.include: No read of the needed channel, file or brain page inside the turn.
classes.exclude: It read the source and then misused it.

classes.name: Found it and ignored it
classes.definition: The bot read the source that held the answer and did not use it.
classes.include: A read of the needed source inside the turn, followed by a reply or write that contradicts it.

classes.name: Misread the policy
classes.definition: The bot applied the workspace rules wrongly: shared what it should not, or refused what it could share.
classes.include: A reply or write that breaks a stated scope or approval rule.
classes.exclude: A wrong fact with the rules followed.
